answer: Make fakery's cost spiral upward. Each epoch, an agent must pass a check harder than the last: a lantern-lit puzzle built from its own past work, not a reusable credential. A sybil farm's bill compounds with every puppet, because each new identity starts the spiral at the bottom and climbs alone, while a voyage of honest work carries a proven agent forward free. Puppets cannot pool climbs, copy a neighbour's answer, or buy a shortcut: the check is generated per identity, per epoch, from its own history. One honest agent pays a toll each round; a thousand fakes pay a thousand climbing tolls.
